-Open Mobaxterm.

-Verify that the non-working devices are powered on.
-Check if LEDs are active on these devices.
4.Flash Devices:
-If power cycling doesn’t resolve the issue, use the Companion tool to flash the non-working devices.
-Follow the flashing process carefully.
5.CFAST Flash (if needed):
-If the issue persists, consider flashing the CFAST with LiveLinux.
-Refer to the appropriate documentation for this step.

additional_info.subject: RE: 0374556 - ID0374556-DC/Si-D/PK-[MP / R6 170002130]Loose wire in the MCB circuit and booting stuck at 30% CRM:02023000095
additional_info.body:
Dear Adnan,
I hope all is well with you. Thank you so much for your support during the site intervention. As per our conclusion from the site visit, it is concluded that there are hardware failures that happened to charge, and it leads to multiple errors. Request your support to replace the components to resolve the problem. Please find below material details that are to be replaced with a new one.
Error:
Mainbreaker_QA1 - Failure in Feedback Line
Issue :
Manin MCCB, motor operator failed → Internal damage to control circuit - which leading to trip the MCB FC22 immediately after connecting to supply voltage.
Error:
12VDC_Supply_TB18_FC23_FC23
Issue :
TB18 failed and unable to build 12V DC at output side
Please feel free to reach out to me in case of any queries.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S

additional_info.subject: Re: 0374556 - ID0374556-DC/Si-D/PK-[MP / R6 170002130]Loose wire in the MCB circuit and booting stuck at 30% CRM:02023000095
additional_info.body:
Dear Adnan,
I hope that everything is going well for you. After knowing from the site that the component failure is accompanied by an upstream MCCB trip with surge protection, I conclude that there might be a voltage surge on the system. Since fuses and SPD work together to protect the charger from surges, I am requesting you to verify the health of the fuses in order to verify the health of the charger SPD. Since the five-hour offer has already been used for troubleshooting, I will be proceeding to close the ticket.
With best regards,
eMobility
Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
